items.title: Sandisk and More Chip Stocks Hit China Roadblocks
items.summary: FEATURE  China threw up a couple of roadblocks for chips stocks Monday, forcing Sandisk ASML Holding and a host of others into the ditch. The obstacles: a massive Chinese IPO and a state-backed company’s mass production of chip-making machines.

items.title: CXMT, Sandisk, ASML, SpaceX, D-Wave Quantum, Workday, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  A chip stock slide weighed on the major indexes following reports that a state-backed Chinese company has begun mass producing chip-making machines. Those same semiconductor companies, and many artificial-intelligence names, also were under pressure Monday after Chinese memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies ’(CXMT) massive trading debut.

The launch includes systems supporting up to 256 CPU cores, new rack scale AI infrastructure, and the Helios Platform with up to 72 GPUs for large scale AI training.
